A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have created a design process that is iterative, participatory and interdisciplinary, and which is informed by the needs and interests of the end users, their caregivers, and our interdisciplinary team.

ABLE is an interactive platform that uses gesture based technology and a variety of creative activities (art and music creation and gaming) to engage participants in playful, physical interactions that enhance strength, balance and cognitive function.

we are seeking to develop an interactive platform for older adults that is both engaging and effective, and that can be used independently or with support, in a range of environments, to enhance physical, cognitive and emotional health and wellness.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we can design interactive platforms that can be tailored to the needs of a wide range of users with diverse needs, and that we can design these to be used in a variety of settings, from home to residence.
we can design for the diverse needs of the elderly population, by integrating their needs into our research process and by designing for the diverse needs and interests of this population.
